body:
for https://github.com/metalbear-co/operator/issues/361.

- Define a `MirrordPolicy` CRD.
- Write that CRD to the setup file.
- Create new ResponseError variant for reporting actions being forbidden by a policy.
  - This means that if a user is running a mirrord version that is older than the installed operator, and the operator blocks an operation because of a policy, mirrord would error because it couldn't parse the message. I think this is better than not sending back the block feedback, since the application would probably error weirdly either way and at least with the extra info we can make newer mirrord versions display helpful information when blocked by a policy. What do you think?

**Edit**: after writing this I realized maybe returning a permission denied IO error + remote log with block info is better and does not break protocol.


**I rebased/squashed and amended commits to group together related changes and make it easier to follow and see the big picture, so I recommend reading 1 commit at a time, and reading the commit messages first.**

author: 333fred
body: Today, when ENCing, we avoid actually emitting IL for members that were not touched by the user, and filter out diagnostics from locations that they didn't touch. However, we still calculate diagnostics for the entire compilation, which is a lot of unnecessary work that will be filtered out. To address this, we plumb the existing symbol filter through `Symbol.ForceComplete`, avoiding working on symbols that should not be completed for this ENC session. Closes https://github.com/dotnet/roslyn/issues/70212.

body:
# Problem

For logging, DD_TAGS [should be space separated](https://github.com/DataDog/datadog-agent/blob/21cb9b2ac809ed90a92b030bff59ee66e745e778/pkg/config/config_template.yaml#L129), per the docs. We changed to that on 11/16 and that's been working since. But at the same time we lost tagging on metrics because [they're required to be comma-separated](https://github.com/DataDog/dogstatsd-ruby/blob/3feb50f0bc44e5ac627a4397fb31e8295e63594e/lib/datadog/statsd/serialization/tag_serializer.rb#L82). (edited)

# Solution

Spaces have been in use since [datadog-agent 6.0](https://github.com/datadog/datadog-agent/commit/75fa4ea05a546e9e1b3c715898dcc0f1389b1b08#diff-2c623f3c6a917be56c59d43279244996836262cb1e12d9d0786c9c49eef6b43cR70-R71) in 2018. This PR adds space splitting to be consistent with datadog-agent expectations but keeps comma splitting to maintain backward compatibility.

author: tonychen2001
body:
* [x] _The Jira issue number for this PR is: MDEV-26923_

## Description

This change makes the effort to reduce the number of server restarts required due to passing invalid options.

Previously, the behavior was to error out on the first invalid option encountered. With this change, a best effort approach is made so that all invalid options processed will be printed before exiting.

There is a caveat. The options are processed many times at varying stages of server startup because the server is not aware of all valid options immediately (e.g. plugins have to be loaded first before the server knows what are the available plugin options). So, there are some options that the server can determine are invalid "early" on, and there are some options that the server cannot determine are invalid until "later" on. For example, the server can determine an option such as `--a` is an ambiguous option very early on but an option such as `--this-does-not-match-any-option` cannot be labelled as invalid until the server is aware of all available options.

Thus, it is possible that the server will still fail before printing out all "invalid" options. You can see this by passing `--a --obvious-invalid-option`.

body: ## Summary: Following up on #2140, this PR focuses on adding theming support to the ModalPanel component. This PR also includes a new theme for the `khanmigo` theme that is used to support the `eggplant` background. Issue: WB-1652 ## Test plan: 1. Verify that the ModalPanel component can be themed by using the `khanmigo` theme. http://localhost:6061/?path=/story/modal-building-blocks-modalpanel--dark Check that the background color of the modal panel is `eggplant` when using the `khanmigo` theme and is `darkBlue` when using the default theme. https://github.com/Khan/wonder-blocks/assets/843075/3ebee616-6a23-42a2-aee1-6b7f15faba6c 2. Verify that the new ModalDialog story displays correctly the new `khanmigo` theme.
